contract.Bell: vertical ZZ parity, X readouts, fixed padding; 3 cycles on adjacent pair
contract.CCZ_supply: accepted correlated triple at specified sites before injection; no supply wait
contract.CNOT: 2 cycles; full directed path; vertex-disjoint concurrency
contract.H: 3 cycles; full 2x2 deformation and restored orientation
contract.area: whole rectangle, including all idle and resource patches
contract.corrections: all routed conditional slots reserved; branches retain predicates
contract.data: fixed source placement, original source SWAPs routed as three CNOTs
contract.factories_delivery: excluded under the same conditional supply convention
contract.optimization_imported: none; no optimized paper paths, timings, matrices, or AES interfaces coordination
contract.reset: 1 cycle for both consumed resource and injection ports
